title: Breakfast at the hotel
instructions: Bir misafir otelde kahvaltı hakkında soru soruyor. Saat, yer ve fiyata dikkat et.

script.speaker: guest
script.text: Excuse me. What time is breakfast?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: It's from seven to ten o'clock.

script.speaker: staff
script.text: In the restaurant, on the ground floor, next to the lift.

script.speaker: guest
script.text: Is breakfast in the price of my room?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: No, I'm sorry. It's twelve euros.

script.speaker: guest
script.text: Can I have breakfast in my room?

script.speaker: staff
script.text: Yes, but it is fifteen euros.

script.speaker: guest
script.text: OK. I'll go to the restaurant.

questions.feedback: Kahvaltı yediden ona kadar; onda bitiyor.
questions.evidence: It's from seven to ten o'clock.
on the ground floor, next to the lift.
